Companion Animal Travel Desk check-in and transfer guidance

Use this guide to prepare a companion animal booking with Aurelia Skyways. Follow the steps in order so the welcome team can review the animal, the kennel, and the travel plan without delay. Keep every document ready before you arrive, and keep the pet calm and secured until a staff member asks for the next step.

At check-in, the staff will confirm that the animal matches the reservation, that the carrier is safe, and that the traveler has the required form. <<FACT F086>> Bring the carrier in good condition, with secure latches, clean bedding, and enough space for the animal to stand and turn. If the animal is nervous, speak softly and wait for staff guidance before opening the kennel.

During transfer review, the process moves through a calm stepwise check so the team can protect the animal and reduce confusion. If the first review does not resolve the issue, the matter is sent forward for a higher level of handling. <<FACT F106>> Keep the booking details available and follow instructions exactly, because missing information slows the transfer and may affect the onward plan.

If your pet needs a quarantine room after arrival at Port Isolde, staff will direct you to the correct intake path and explain what happens next. <<FACT F027>> Do not leave the area until the welcome team confirms the animal has been accepted into the proper holding process. If you are traveling with more than one animal, wait for staff direction before separating carriers or changing labels.

For smooth service, arrive prepared, answer questions clearly, and keep the animal under control at all times. Aurelia Skyways relies on steady cooperation to keep companion travel dependable for travelers and pets alike. For more help, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
